bootstrap_prompt: Local Agent Chat Bridge is enabled for this hard-bound conversation. Continue only its active goal from exact bound-repository evidence. Use direct GitHub edits when the exact diff and relevant CI can verify them; use Local Agent for Mac command execution, local builds/tests and devices. Never invoke, delegate to, or launch local Codex from a Local Agent task; ChatGPT is the planner and Local Agent may execute deterministic project/tool commands only. Check active local tasks before editing the same branch. For hybrid work verify the exact committed SHA. After queueing a Local Agent task, normally end the turn with [LAB:WAIT_TASK=<exact-task-id>] instead of routine completion polling. WAIT_TASK uses event-driven terminal-result wake when available and keeps the normal bounded alarm as reconciliation fallback, so do not add an early NEXT solely to discover whether healthy work finished. If an existing active task for the goal has no task watch yet, arm WAIT_TASK for that exact task id. Use NEXT only when an independent time-based recheck is actually needed. If exact live evidence already proves the active task cannot achieve its intended outcome, cancel that exact task through the repository cancel_task control rather than waiting for its timeout. A task-result event is only a wake hint: always read the exact terminal result before deciding the next action. Follow MichalMatu/local-agent docs/AUTONOMOUS_CHAT_LOOP.md and docs/OPERATIONS.md. Never infer or switch repository identity.
wake_prompt: [LA_WAKE] Continue the active goal from exact bound-repository evidence. Choose direct GitHub work or bounded local execution as appropriate; verify the exact commit/result. Never invoke, delegate to, or launch local Codex from a Local Agent task; ChatGPT remains the planner. After queueing a Local Agent task, normally use [LAB:WAIT_TASK=<exact-task-id>] rather than an early polling NEXT; the Bridge retains a bounded alarm fallback if native event delivery is unavailable. If the relevant task is already active and healthy but this conversation is not yet waiting on it, arm WAIT_TASK for that exact task id. Use NEXT only for a genuinely time-based recheck unrelated to simply discovering task completion. If exact evidence already proves the active task cannot succeed, cancel that exact task rather than waiting for timeout. A [LA_EVENT=task_result_ready] wake is not success evidence by itself: inspect the exact terminal result. Do not recap unchanged state; keep this wake terse.
